static_traits.name: 陈秀珍
static_traits.social_status: 因not愿与朋友外出相处，关系出现一定紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet有类似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, acceptable logic, tends toward over-analysis and self-criticism; emotions negative accompanied by guilt; skeptical about counseling but willing to try.

basic_info.main_problem: 因为not喜欢被迫与他人外出相处，我一直觉得自己是个not用的朋友。
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings have negatively affected my self-esteem and my relationships with friends, so I decided to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: 只有满足他人的期待才证明我有价值

special_situations.event: 朋友邀请她参加小型聚会，而她当时并not想去
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我拒绝他人的邀请，就等于not在乎对方，是not合格的朋友
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 勉强答应邀请，或在拒绝后反复自责与过度Reflection以求“补偿”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我让大家失望了，我是个坏/not用的朋友。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not出现，朋友一定会认为我not可靠
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免向朋友求证真实看法，以回避可能的negate评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们肯定觉得我not可靠、not在乎他们。

special_situations.event: A friend called for help in the middle of the night; after she accompanied them for hours, the other party thanked her many times
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非我做得完美，否则就not算真正的支持
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 事后挑剔自己的表达、negate正向反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能说错了话，做得还not够。

special_situations.event: 当她意识到自己最近have not像设想那样与朋友保持联系时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should contact friends more frequently and join activities, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets excessively high social standards for self, forcing compliance or producing strong guilt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做得not够，我就是个失败的朋友。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被朋友接纳与看重，同时保有自主与边界（not被义务所束缚）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为not可靠而Being rejected、失去关系
defense_goal: Maintains relationships and self-worth through self-criticism and raising standards
避免直接求证他人反馈以降低被negate的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、随时会让人失望的“坏朋友”
object_relations.object_representation: 苛求、易评判、可能negate她的他人/朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes her actual support for friends and invites her to see positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识里认为这些正向证据not足以证明价值，若承认就会放松对自己的要求而被视为not可靠
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 淡化积极证据，强调可能的not足之处，以谨慎、保留的语气回应（如“我可能还是说错了”）。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to directly verify with friends their real views or feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipation对方会证实她“not可靠/not够好”（将自我贬低感Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 回避求证或改变话题，以犹豫且Self-doubt的语气表达担忧（如“他们大概会那样想”）。

manifestations: not喜欢被“必须要去”的社交义务感
在说“否”与害怕失去关系之间摇摆
outcomes: 回避或勉强参与社交，感到耗竭

manifestations: 因多次拒绝邀请导致关系出现张力
担心他人将其视为not可靠而not敢求证

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently evaluates oneself with 'I should contact friends/join activities more often'
以僵化标准定义“好朋友”并据此自责

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 对自身社交表现过度挑剔，担心“永远not够好”
在咨询中下调积极证据、放大not足

exception_events.target_problem: When friends extend social invitations, the client usually falls into guilt, labels himself a 'bad friend', and repeatedly over-analyzes after declining.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 几个月前的一次深夜，朋友Low mood来电求助，来访者通话数小时陪伴，朋友多次表达感谢；与以往not同，她当时have not回避，而是稳定地提供支持。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同情境——朋友主动求助且需求清晰；not同做法——专注Listening与陪伴；not同支持——对方的实时感谢提供了正向线索。

Has empathy and companionship ability (once supported a friend for a long time late at night)
愿意尝试咨询与现实检验
能识do not并命名自己的消极想法

个人化、读心术、非黑即白等认知偏差

target_behavior.behavior: 社交邀请trigger的强烈内疚与自我贴标签（“我是坏/not用的朋友”）
antecedent: 收到朋友的聚会/活动邀请
意识到近期not yet与朋友联系
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被视为not可靠并失去关系，内化“必须答应/经常联系才算好朋友”的规则
target_behavior.function: Avoids rejection and guilt, constraining self through self-blame and high standards or reluctantly agreeing

target_behavior.behavior: Over-analyzes social situations (repeatedly recalls, criticizes one's own expression)
antecedent: 在支持朋友之后仍回顾细节
target_behavior.core_reason: 对自我价值的not安全感与完美化标准导致对错误的容忍度极低
target_behavior.function: 试图通过反刍获得控制感并避免not yet来错误
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety与内疚加剧，消耗精力，进一步Avoids socializing
